messages:
dev-jen: Publish failed during staging window. ECR rejected manifest: missing annotation 'org.redwood.build_id' :warning:

deploy-bot: automated: Publish blocked for eu-ecr.redwood/service-x@sha256:abc123: provenance lint missing required annotation 'org.redwood.build_id' -> reject.

infra-mike: probably a buildpack regression that dropped the field. Previous pinned digest sha256:111aaa is healthy. Recommend pinning staging and locking pipeline.

release-lead: Decision: hold the release window. Pin staging to sha256:111aaa and lock auto-promote for job=service-x-nightly. If republish delayed >60m, escalate.

dev-jen: I can patch the pipeline to inject build_id and rebuild. ETA ~20m. Note: republish of identical output won't create a new digest; we'll force a rebuild.

deploy-bot: automated: Lock applied for job=service-x-nightly by release-lead. Route staging/service-x pinned to sha256:111aaa by release-lead.

dev-jen: Rebuild complete. New image published eu-ecr.redwood/service-x@sha256:222bbb. Validation passed. Promotion requires manual approve.

release-lead: Start canary 5% for 10m. Rollback plan: if error rate >1% revert to sha256:111aaa and notify oncall.

infra-mike: Canary healthy at +6m. Unpinning and unlocking pipeline.

deploy-bot: automated: Route staging/service-x unpinned by infra-mike. Job service-x-nightly unlocked.

release-lead: Closing hold. Filing follow-up INF ticket to add pre-publish lint for required annotations and a CI test.
